visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three women in green heart-shaped bird masks pose in a hallway. One wears a green bodysuit, another a green top with a black skirt, and the third a black and green top with 'BRASIL' text. The setting features light wood panels and a large mirror. (2) A man in a grey hoodie and tan cap sits on a large black leather sofa playing a handheld game console. He looks focused. Behind him, a woman wearing the Duolingo bird mask appears and looms over him silently. (3) Two more masked women join, surrounding the man on the sofa. He reacts with surprise and stress, covering his face as they loom over him. The background shows a spacious living room with shelves and a pet cage. (4) The man is in bed under grey covers. Two masked women jump on the bed, one swinging a long green toy, aggressively waking and harassing him. He tries to block them with his arms in the dimly lit bedroom. (5) In a study area, the man sits on an exercise ball reading a comic book. A masked woman approaches and hands him a smartphone. The room is well-lit with wooden floors and background furniture including a dollhouse. (6) Two more masked women appear, all pointing phones at the man while he cowers in distress on the exercise ball. He holds his face in his hands. The lighting is bright and even across the scene. (7) The three masked women stand together in the initial hallway with wooden walls and a mirror. They have their arms crossed and look towards the camera, maintaining a stern posture despite the comical masks.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Montage of persistent stalking -> Final pose
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A comedic short film playing on the viral 'Duolingo bird stalking you' meme. It depicts a man being relentlessly followed and harassed by individuals in Duolingo mascot masks at various times of the day, including while gaming, sleeping, and reading. The video humorously exaggerates the persistent nature of language learning app notifications through personification.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The prominent and consistent use of the Duolingo mascot masks serves as a clear reference to the brand, leveraging its established internet meme culture for comedic effect.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes the song 'Unstoppable' by Sia to reinforce the theme of the mascot's relentless and unavoidable pursuit.
